dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the visible posterior termination.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, dark, transverse linear mark is visible on the posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark horizontal scar or mark located on the lower third of the visible dorsal surface.
